CdA_m2.interpretation: Broad literature support spanning track/TT/sprint postures; not a Japanese-keirin population distribution.

drafting.interpretation: Position/spacing/posture dependent sensitivity support. Explicitly replaces any temptation to encode a universal symmetric same-line bonus.

peak_power_W.interpretation: Support envelope only. Class/rider/form-conditioned Japanese-keirin power state remains uncalibrated.

drivetrain_efficiency.interpretation: Cycling chain-drive literature sensitivity support only.

rolling_resistance.interpretation: A common modeling reference exists, but track model literature emphasizes tyre/slip/camber dependence. Fail closed rather than inventing a keirin range.

333m_race_level_PRE.selection_note: The initially fixed 5R was Girls L1 and therefore outside the already frozen narrow MEN FI/FII reality slice. It was not used as male calibration evidence; the next eligible male race 7R was used instead.

335m_race_level_PRE.note: No Maebashi race card was available for 2026-09-01 in the checked public schedule. No post-hoc historical result was substituted.

weather_wind_transport.official_support: KEIRIN guide explicitly notes wind direction and wind speed as rider decision factors.
weather_wind_transport.rule: Do not substitute a generic engineering wind distribution. A venue/time-bound observation or explicit proxy contract is still required.

mutable_line_transport.official_support: Official guide says riders show intended line formation during rider introduction/leg-show before start.
mutable_line_transport.provider_observation: KDreams race pages expose provider-supplied line predictions before cutoff; these are PRE_EVENT_EXPECTED_LINE candidates, not LEGSHOW_OBSERVED_LINE truth.
mutable_line_transport.rule: Expected and observed line states remain distinct. No provider prediction may be silently upgraded to observed line.

longitudinal_rider_state.official_observation: KEIRIN rider profile pages expose timestamped current rolling statistics (example observed update 2026-09-01 07:00).
longitudinal_rider_state.rule: Repeated future snapshots can support longitudinal transition calibration. Current/latest values cannot be backfilled into old decision points.
